input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is PAINTING STYLE ONLY, never copy its person, framing or pose. Keep the same face, headwear, clothes and single set of equipment. Adult woman, dark curly hair and blue hood, ivory/pale-blue split layered cloth, water glass charms, worn silver clasps, crescent orb staff. Compact mist and droplets. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 separate complete poses of ONE SAME character. Read left to right, top to bottom. Row 1: four keys of a QUICK FLINCH AND RECOVERY: 1 ready upright pose; 2 sharp unmistakable recoil with shoulders and head pulled BACK by one head-width and torso bent back 25 degrees; 3 shoulders returning and braced bent legs; 4 upright recovered ready pose. These four poses MUST visibly differ, not four standing duplicates. Row 2: first four keys of a BIGGER STAGGER: 5 upright ready; 6 abrupt backward bend of upper body; 7 deepest backward bend, arms pulled close, balance visibly lost; 8 lower body catches the weight, bent knees or legs. Row 3: 9 pushing back upright, visibly struggling; 10 upright recovered. Then begin COLLAPSE: 11 ready upright; 12 legs buckle and body drops. Row 4: continue COLLAPSE: 13 body very low, leaning toward ground; 14 torso falls sideways nearly horizontal; 15 body settles FULLY LYING on its side, head and entire torso on ground; 16 body completely still FULLY LYING ON GROUND, legs extended or naturally folded, equipment resting beside it. The final TWO poses must be completely horizontal resting bodies, never crouching, kneeling, sitting or getting back up. Treat collapse as a harmless theatrical fall/rest pose, fully intact. No blood, gore, wounds or injury detail. No attacker, impact flash or effects. Each of the 16 equal cells contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 65% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.

arguments.Prompt:
A master hand-painted digital dark fantasy character animation sprite sheet arranged in a precise 4x4 grid (exactly 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows, totaling 16 distinct poses) on a solid, flat, uniform vivid MAGENTA background (#FF00FF). Wide, clean magenta gutters separate all cells. No grid lines, borders, labels, or text.

Character Identity & Equipment (maintain exact design from Reference-1.png):
Adult female water mage (Cassia). She has dark curly hair peeking out from an ivory/pale-blue hood, wearing layered split cloth robes of pale ivory and pale muted blue with worn silver clasps and dangling glass water charms. She holds a worn dark metal staff topped with a crescent moon holding an orb. Subtle compact water droplets and mist near the staff. Painted in the visual style of Reference-2.png: sculpted painterly volume, smooth opaque paint, soft cool upper-left lighting, broken confident contours, muted realistic fantasy palette, no thick cartoon outlines, no 3D render look.

Perspective & Camera Angle:
Uniform across ALL 16 poses: High 55-degree orthographic elevated angle, viewed from a REAR-RIGHT three-quarter perspective (facing diagonally away from viewer, looking toward the right, showing the back of the hood, shoulders, and back of robes). Every pose maintains this exact camera angle and rear-right orientation, including fallen poses. Identical anatomical scale in every frame, centered within the middle 65% of each cell with generous magenta margins.

The 16 poses sequence from left to right, top to bottom:

Row 1 (Flinch & Quick Recovery):
Cell 1 (Col 1, Row 1): Idle ready upright stance, rear-right view, holding staff.
Cell 2 (Col 2, Row 1): Sharp recoil/flinch: head and shoulders jerked backward by one head-width, torso recoiling back 25 degrees, staff pulled inward.
Cell 3 (Col 3, Row 1): Recovery transition: torso returning forward, legs bent and braced, stabilizing balance.
Cell 4 (Col 4, Row 1): Recovered upright ready stance, settled back into position.

Row 2 (Deep Stagger - Part 1):
Cell 5 (Col 1, Row 2): Upright ready stance.
Cell 6 (Col 2, Row 2): Abrupt heavy impact recoil: upper body snapping violently backward.
Cell 7 (Col 3, Row 2): Deepest stagger: torso arched far back, arms and staff pulled close defensively, balance visibly lost, heels lifting.
Cell 8 (Col 4, Row 2): Stumble catch: lower body absorbing the momentum with deeply bent knees and wide stance.

Row 3 (Stagger Recovery & Collapse Start):
Cell 9 (Col 1, Row 3): Straining forward, pushing back upright with effort, gripping staff for leverage.
Cell 10 (Col 2, Row 3): Fully recovered upright ready stance.
Cell 11 (Col 3, Row 3): Start of collapse: upright stance faltering, sudden loss of energy.
Cell 12 (Col 4, Row 3): Knees buckling, hips dropping downward, sinking toward the floor.

Row 4 (Collapse & Ground Resting Poses):
Cell 13 (Col 1, Row 4): Low collapse: body crouching very low, leaning forward-right toward ground, staff slipping down.
Cell 14 (Col 2, Row 4): Falling sideways: torso nearly horizontal, tipping toward the ground.
Cell 15 (Col 3, Row 4): Settling on ground: lying fully horizontal on side/back, head and entire torso resting flat on the ground.
Cell 16 (Col 4, Row 4): Complete still rest: fully lying flat on ground on side/back, motionless, limbs naturally resting, staff lying peacefully alongside her.

Clean composition, pure #FF00FF magenta background, no floor textures, no shadows except tiny contact shadows under feet/body, no gore or injury, no effects obscuring the character.
